title: Tomb of Hamza (a)
introduction:
TOMB OF HAMZA (A)

The shrine is near to the shrine of Al-Kasim on the road of Hilla, Diwaniyah, and it is famous among people that the tomb of Hamza bin I. Musa bin Jaafar, this is not the truth but he is Hamza Bin Qasim ibn Ali ibn Hamza Bin Al-Hussein bin Abdullah bin Abu Fadl Abbas ibn ibn Ali Bin Abi Talib is one of the sons of Abi Al- Fadl Al- Abbas (peace be upon him).
